params.name: authMethod
params.description: Authentication method to use: HTTP basic (1) or HTTP digest (2).

sentinelValues.meaning: Let 4D negotiate the authentication method automatically; 4D sends an additional request to determine the method the server requires.

params.description: If passed, the credentials are intended for an HTTP proxy rather than the target server; pass this in addition to a non-starred call if both the proxy and the server require authentication.

overloads.semanticRole: Registers client credentials to be encoded into the next HTTP request sent via HTTP Request or HTTP Get.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: HTTP client protocol: HTTP AUTHENTICATE / HTTP SET OPTION / HTTP SET CERTIFICATES FOLDER configure per-process client state -> HTTP Get or HTTP Request issues the request and consumes that state -> HTTP GET OPTION / HTTP Get certificates folder read back the currently active state.

constraints: Encoded credentials are attached only to the next HTTP Request or HTTP Get call in the current process; if the 'HTTP reset auth settings' option (set via HTTP SET OPTION) is enabled, credentials are discarded after each request and this command must be called again before every subsequent request.
